name: Chongqing Yufu Capital Operation Group Co., Ltd. (重庆渝富资本运营集团有限公司)
via: holds 1,960,661,852 shares of Southwest Securities (600369.SH), 29.51% of its total share capital; wholly owned by Chongqing Yufu Holdings Group
note: Southwest Securities' announcement of 7 March 2026 states Yufu Capital holds 29.51% of the brokerage and that the company's actual controller remains the Chongqing Municipal SASAC (the planned transfer of the same stake to Yufu Holdings was terminated that month). The Chongqing SASAC portal describes Yufu Capital as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Yufu Holdings, with registered capital RMB 10 billion.
